description: Jest 30.5.2's outcome for an error the code never handles while a file runs, one file per timing, in band: a timer that throws while its test still runs, a timer that throws after its test ended (while the next test runs, during a later describe's beforeAll, during the file's afterAll), a rejection nobody handles while its test runs and one made after it ended, and a timer no test owns (scheduled at module scope). Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a code frame, a test list line (those carry durations), a time, a count line or runner noise. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-uncaught.test.ts`.
